items.title: Vertiv (VRT) Stock Looks Below Fair Value After Recent Deals
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co has seen its stock swing sharply in recent weeks, which puts fresh attention on a basic question for investors: how much of today’s price is really supported by the cash the business can generate over time. Vertiv has delivered a very large share price gain of about 588.0% over the past 5 years, so a lot of expectations about its future cash flows are already embedded in the story.
